newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks seen opening softer, extending fall.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks seen opening softer, extending fall.

text.p: * Toronto stocks are forecast to slip at Monday's open,
following New York's lead as it extends Friday's tumble. *
Gold stocks seen firmer but may not stem overall losses.
Toronto's key stock index will likely drop at the open, pulled lower by the big board as it stretches Friday's weakness to Monday.

"You'll probably see the market sell off early," one trader said. The Toronto Stock Exchange's 300 Composite Index snapped a three-day winning streak on Friday, dropping 49.92 to end at 6895.15. Wall Street fell more than 156 points.
"It's also Monday in the summertime, which means quiet time," another trader said.
Heavyweight gold issues could stem early losses, buoyed by stronger bullion prices, traders agreed.
